description: The core PR gate's profile (tap#366, stage 3 of the plugin-CI epic tap#363): core + the fixture plugins the core suite's coverage guards need + ONE flagship canary with its declared dependencies. NOT the full set — `test_all` keeps that role (it is the bill of materials the BOM lane boots); this profile is bounded by tap/tests/test_core_ci_profile.py, which refuses any plugin that is neither a fixture nor the canary's dependency closure, and which requires every pin here to equal test_all's for the same slug (one place a plugin version lives; scripts/release-plugin.sh bumps both). Seeds the canary's GRIFT so the core contract suite (tap_plugins/tests/test_plugin_contract.py) exercises a real plugin end to end; fires no collectors.

plugins.note: Fixture: the neutral grid_fixtures__* vocabulary the core suites build fixtures from (tap.plugin_testing.BASELINE_PLUGIN_SLUGS).
Fixture: the Gridkin scenario corpus + harness that exercise the Gryphon query language; owns no types, depends_on grid_fixtures.
Fixture: the in-tree validate_plugin test target (tap_plugin.validation_sample); no GRIFT seed, no deps.
Canary dependency: github_core's manifest depends_on identity_core (the oidc_issuer convergence node + issuer helper); installed before the canary.
Canary: the flagship consumer plugin (the git-serious product's substrate). Its declared dependency closure is the only non-fixture set this profile may carry.
